title: KENWORTH T909 Custom Built Powder Coated FUPS compliant 5 post Road Train Bullbar #96
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile painted aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar 381high tensile channel. 88mm diameter pipe with 6mm wall but optional 76mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. All pipes are one piece, no but welds to uprights. Extra Heavy Reinforced 5 post design ensures maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. 100mm full length reinforced box uprights shown. Cow catcher and 3 small uprights. Reversible aluminium road train signs with KW logo on reverse side. Provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty steel backing plate with 38mm tow pin plus tow plate surround. Spring assist to help raise and lower the bar. Large Range of Powder Coat colours available. A heavy duty driving light bar is mounted to the bonnet. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
